findings: The company reports that its Lotus Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolyzers are modular, interlocking systems with a dynamic ramping range of 8 seconds from minimum to full load and an industry-leading stack efficiency of 45 kWh/kg.

findings: Ohmium Operations Private Limited launched its second green hydrogen electrolyzer gigafactory in Doddaballapura, Bengaluru, in July 2024, ramping up to ship 2 GW of fully assembled and tested Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems annually.

The company reports that the 14,000 square meter facility consolidates manufacturing, assembly, quality assurance, testing, warehousing, and shipping under one roof and is designed for an expansion potential up to 4 GW by 2026.

The rating reflects the company's clear and verifiable gigawatt-scale production capability established via a newly commissioned 2 GW manufacturing plant near Bengaluru that is designed for modular mass production.

findings: The company reports that its Lotus PEM electrolyzer systems feature a hyper-modular, interlocking design that integrates the balance of plant, power electronics, water treatment, purification, and cooling to convert AC power and water into high-purity hydrogen, using standardized 4.2 MW island blocks to scale from megawatt to gigawatt sizes.

Ohmium's modular product specifications include the E series and P series systems, providing distinct pressure outputs (up to 10 barg vs. 30 barg) and variant efficiency levels packaged into ready-to-use, crane-free horizontal layouts with a compact footprint of 29.7 m²/MW.
We verified that the company offers fully integrated, hyper-modular PEM electrolyzer systems spanning specific pressure models and configured into standardized scalable island blocks.
